notes.title: Nominate Leap of Faith for Outstanding Story-Rich category in the Steam Awards.
notes.content:
Ok, before you think I've lost my mind, I know that I'm in the micro-developer league against multi-million dollar game companies.

And yes, I also know that this is an adult game, where the audience is nowhere near the mainstream numbers.

Will it reach the nominations at all? Probably not, but my one and only goal in making this game was to tell a story. While making it, and after, I've received thousands of messages thanking me for doing so.

So in all humbleness of the very good company I'm in here at Steam, I hope you will consider giving Leap of Faith a vote for the Steam Awards for 2022.

Thank you very much for your time, and Stay Safe out there.

notes.title: Leap of Faith - Walkthrough DLC out now.
notes.content:
Ever wondered what your in-game choices do? How to unlock a scene? Or want to know a bit about how the game was made? See concept renders and other content that were scrapped along the way?

The Walkthrough DLC is an in-game mod/walkthrough that shows you the way. You can easily enable or disable the walkthrough, extras or text commentary so you only see the elements you want to see on the screen at any time.

Head over to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2122800/Leap_of_Faith__In_Game_WalkthroughExtra_material/]the store page[/url] for more information.

Have fun playing.

// Drifty

notes.title: Leap of Faith reinstated on the Steam Store
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41719006/d658573497c4df4e0733c3db2bb92dd949098e2e.png[/img]

I'm happy to announce that the Steam issue has been resolved, and that Leap of Faith is once again available to buy.

Leap of Faith is, for now, a silent game, but I will review my music licenses (new and old) for the release of the 8th and final chapter.

I am truly sorry for the delay in giving any information about this, but I didn't know any more than you up until today.

[b]Chapter 8 - Development progress[/b]

At the time of writing, chapter 8 is about 75% done. I've done my best to make sure you'll get a good ending, no matter which girl you've chosen, and with more than 50 variation endings, there should be something for everyone.

I've worked my way through every path except Lexi, which is what I'm doing now. After she's done, I will shift my attention to the big scene that is the main event/finale of the game, and should give Leap of Faith a worthy ending.

If you're an avid VN reader, you should be able to recognize a face or two from that finale, as there are more than 130 guests from other VNs present.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41719006/0d12478a8b3abf0d6007848a43f8e3d952af1237.png[/img]

The trailer will be out soon, but until then, stay safe out there, and thank you very much the the encouragement and kind words.

// Drifty

notes.title: Leap of Faith is now available on Steam
notes.content:
I hope you have a good time playing the game, joining Cece, Lexi, Linda, Robin, Kira, and Steph for a summer you will never forget. Don't forget to give it a review, even if it wasn't to your liking.

A huge thank you to those who have been following me for a while and seen the story materialize the last two years.

Cheers, and stay safe out there.

// Drifty
